Table of Contents

Namespace BOOSEapp

Classes

AppCanvas

Custom canvas implementation used by the BOOSE interpreter. Responsible for drawing shapes and managing the drawing cursor.

AppCommandFactory

Custom command factory used to create BOOSE commands. It extends the default command factory and returns application-specific command implementations.

ApplicationConfiguration

Bootstrap the application configuration.

Array

Array interpreter extension for BOOSE, adding support for array variables. Supports int variables, real variables, int arrays, real arrays, together with poke, peek and simple write commands.

Circle

BOOSE command that draws a circle on the canvas.

Clear

Clears the drawing canvas.

Form1

Main user interface for the BOOSE interpreter. Allows the user to input BOOSE programs, execute them, and display graphical output on the canvas.

If

Handles IF, ELSE and END IF logic in BOOSE programs.

Int

Simple interpreter extension that adds support for integer variables (int). Allows declaration, assignment and usage of variables in BOOSE commands.

Maths

Provides simple mathematical expression evaluation (+, -, *, /)

MoveTo

BOOSE command that moves the drawing cursor to a specified position on the canvas.

Program
Real

Real variable support for BOOSE interpreter. Allows declaration, assignment and usage of variables in BOOSE commands.

Rectangle

BOOSE command that draws a rectangle on the canvas.

Tri

BOOSE command that draws a triangle on the canvas.
